---
title: "Research"
pagetitle: "Research"
aliases: 
  - in-press.html
# define three listing blocks, each with a filter on `category`
listing:
  - id: publications
    contents: publications
    template: ../ejs/article.ejs
    type: table
    fields:
      - date
      - title
      - author
      - journal-name
    field-display-names: 
      title: "Title"
      date: "Publication Date"
      author: "Author(s)"
      journal-name: "Journal"
    include:
      categories: "Publication"
    sort: "date desc"
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false

  - id: other
    contents: publications
    template: ../ejs/article.ejs
    type: table
    fields:
      - date
      - title
      - author
      - journal-name
    field-display-names: 
      title: "Title"
      date: "Publication Date"
      author: "Author(s)"
      journal-name: "Journal"
    include:
      categories: "Other"
    sort: "date desc"
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
title-block-banner: false
lightbox: true
